mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LGCOM_USER_SCREEN_LAYOUT_N ( APPLICATION_USER_ID, PROGRAM_ID, SCREEN_GRID_NAME, SCREEN_LAYOUT_XML_TEXT, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}, #{programId}, #{componentId}, #{screenLayout}, #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}, SYSDATE, #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT bn.bulletin_board_no , bn.bulletin_board_id , bn.bulletin_board_title , bn.bb_body_content , TO_CHAR(bn.creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS creation_date FROM LGCOM_BOARD_N bn WHERE bn.bulletin_board_id IN (SELECT bulletin_board_id FROM LGCOM_BOARD_MASTER_M WHERE system_code = UPPER(#{USER_SESSION.systemCode}) AND bulletin_board_type_code = 'NB' AND bb_use_flag = 'Y') AND bn.system_code = UPPER(#{USER_SESSION.systemCode}) AND bn.delete_flag = 'N' AND bn.pop_up_alarm_flag = 'Y' AND (bn.period_from_date IS NULL OR bn.period_from_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (bn.period_to_date IS NULL OR bn.period_to_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_USER_BB_READ_LOG_N WHERE application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND bulletin_board_no = bn.bulletin_board_no) ORDER BY bn.bulletin_board_id, bn.bulletin_board_no DESC

SELECT /* uicommon.retrieveRequestFormInfomationFromManual */ article_write_content AS manual_content , etc_attach_file_id AS attach_file_id FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N a WHERE program_id = #{programId} AND language_code = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N WHERE program_id = a.program_id AND language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}),1,#{USER_SESSION.languageCode},(SELECT language_code FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N WHERE program_id = a.program_id AND ROWNUM = 1))
